item.title: Tilo train stopped in Busto Arsizio for almost three hours
item.description: A Tilo train from Malpensa to Biasca remained stuck about 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station: tension and disruptions on board.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Tilo stationary for almost three hours near Busto Arsizio - Train bound from Malpensa to Biasca - Passengers unable to leave the carriages - Another train pushed it into the station
## Key facts - Location → approximately 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station - Route → Milan Malpensa-Biasca - Duration of the stoppage → almost three hours - Suspected cause → technical fault - Solution → coupling and pushing to the station
### The stoppage near the station
On 28 September 2026, a Tilo train bound from Milan Malpensa to Biasca remained stationary for almost three hours approximately 200 meters from Busto Arsizio station. A Ticinese who was on board the train reported what was happening. Several accounts were sent to the newsroom.
According to the account, passengers could not leave the carriages. As time passed, the situation caused tension among the people on board to rise. The witness described an increasingly exasperated reaction, while numerous expletives can be heard in the audio made available.
According to reports, a technical fault is believed to be behind the stoppage. The train was outside the station, a few hundred meters from the point where passengers would have been able to get off. Italian police were present outside the train and did not allow people to leave the carriages.
The doors were opened from time to time to let air circulate. The account, however, speaks of people left without water and of the presence of small children who were crying. There were also passengers on board who urgently needed to return home.
The stoppage therefore involved people with different needs, all forced to wait inside the train while the situation remained at a standstill near Busto Arsizio station. The source reports that, for a long time, it was not possible to walk to the station or continue the journey toward Biasca. ## The tension inside the carriages
### The accounts collected
The account from the Busto Arsizio area mainly conveys the conditions experienced by passengers while they waited. The train was close to the station, but no one could get off. For those on board, this short distance made the duration of the stoppage even more difficult to understand.
“No one can leave the carriages. The people on board are going crazy. They’re saying all kinds of things,” the witness reported. The audio provided confirms the tense atmosphere: numerous curses can be heard, while the journey toward Biasca remains suspended in the Busto Arsizio area.
The difficulties reported include a lack of water, small children crying and several people urgently expressing their desire to get home. The doors were opened only occasionally to allow air to circulate. Outside, the Italian police prevented passengers from getting off the carriages.
The witness also reported that one person became hysterical and attempted to leave the train to escape by crossing the tracks. The authorities then stopped them. The incident occurred within a situation already marked by the prolonged wait, the impossibility of leaving the train and uncertainty over what solution to adopt.
For a few minutes, the possibility of taking the train back to its departure point began to circulate, so that the passengers could be transferred to another train. The witness explained, however, that it was not yet clear how the operation would be managed and warned that the wait could become even longer.
The prospect fueled frustration among those on board. The train was a few hundred meters from a station, but it remained stopped. The source thus describes a wait accompanied by protests, physical discomfort and questions about how the disruption was being managed. ## The train convoy pushed to the station
### Coupling and moving
The turning point came in the 17.55 update. According to what the witness at the scene explained, a solution had finally been found to move the train from where it was.
Another train coupled to the Tilo convoy and pushed it for about 200 metres, as far as Busto Arsizio station. In this way, after almost three hours of waiting, the passengers arrived at the point that was a few hundred metres from the stopped train.
The account highlights the gap between the short distance and the length of the wait. For the witness, that stretch could have been covered on foot in a few minutes, but the passengers had remained inside the carriages until the intervention of the other train.
The solution made it possible to reach the station, but it did not erase the questions about the preceding hours. The witness hypothesised that being kept in those conditions might have been due to safety reasons. At the same time, he reported that the passengers still had doubts about whether a valid alternative existed for managing the stoppage.
The coupling and pushing represented the decisive stage of the incident: the convoy was brought to the station after having remained stuck a few metres from the arrival point. The source provides no further details about the subsequent arrangements for the journey towards Biasca, nor does it indicate the departure time.
It therefore remains documented that the train’s stoppage near the station was followed by its being moved by another train, after the waiting and agitation experienced on board. The person who had attempted to cross the tracks was also stopped by law enforcement, according to what was reported in the reconstruction.

The description of the premiums explains the hardship. For many families, the source writes, they resemble a «mandatory health tax»: it is paid every month, regardless of whether one falls ill or not. To the premium are added the deductible, cost-sharing, and other expenses; when a real health necessity arises, the bill can become even heavier. The source links these figures to the transformation of the problem into an issue that transcends healthcare alone.
When health absorbs a larger portion of income, the text observes, resources are taken away from the home, children, consumption, and savings, even affecting the possibility of living with dignity. The source text sets September 23, 2026, as the date for the concrete progress of the «Caisse Santé Genève» project. item.title: VAT for the 13th AVS: the PLR launches the no
item.description: The Swiss PLR disputes the VAT increase to 8.5% to finance the 13th AVS. The popular vote is scheduled for November 29.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - PLR launches opposition to the VAT increase for the 13th AVS pension - Standard rate: +0.4 percentage points, to 8.5% - The popular vote is scheduled for 29 November - The arguments were presented in Bern
## Key facts - Who → Swiss PLR - Subject → financing the 13th AVS pension through VAT - Increase → 0.4 percentage points, to 8.5% - Approval → in June by the Chambers - Deadline → popular vote on 29 November
Swiss PLR launched today, Monday, the campaign against the VAT increase intended to finance the 13th AVS pension. The party presented its arguments at a press conference in Bern.
The people will vote on the increase in the popular vote on 29 November. The issue put to a vote, according to the PLR's account, does not amount to a dispute over the payment of the 13th AVS pension. What is considered unacceptable is the method chosen to finance it.
### The contested increase
The target is the increase in the standard rate of 0.4 percentage points, to 8.5%, approved by the Chambers in June. PLR describes the increase as harmful to purchasing power and the economy. Its criticism therefore concerns the burden of the measure and the way in which it should support the financing of the benefit.
At the press conference, the party linked the additional burden to household budgets. According to the argument made in Bern, these budgets are already being put under severe strain by increases in health insurance premiums, rents and current expenses. The source does not indicate an individual amount or provide a simulation for individual categories.
PLR also disputes the adequacy of the financing. Co-president Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher argues: «Less than half is financed by this poorly drafted proposal». For the party, therefore, the vote brings together criticism of the cost for households and criticism of the solution's ability to cover the financing of the 13th AVS pension. To delve further into the pension provision section, the reader can consult the guide on AVS e LPP.
The framework provided by the party therefore contains a political assessment on two fronts: the impact of the standard rate and the solution's ability to finance the benefit. The text attributes both assessments to PLR and presents no alternative calculation. The campaign remains focused on the choice of instrument, while the payment of the 13th AVS pension is not called into question. For the cross-border commuter following the debate, the practical key is to distinguish the payment of the 13th AVS pension from its financing. The source says that the former is not being called into question by the PLR; the campaign instead concerns the increase in VAT and the standard rate set at 8,5% after an increase of 0,4 percentage points.
This distinction prevents turning the vote into a decision described by the source as being in favor of or opposed to the 13th itself. The issue identified is the cost of the solution. The PLR links it to purchasing power and the economy, while regarding households it speaks of an additional burden that would weigh heavily on budgets already under pressure from health insurance premiums, rent and current expenses.
### The scope for those living across the border
For a cross-border commuter, the text does not make it possible to calculate a change in pay, net income or personal budget. It does not report individual amounts, consumption, wages or a breakdown of the burden among categories of people. Nor does it provide a separate impact for Canton Ticino.
To avoid conflating different issues, the source does not address the G permit, LPP, LAMal, withholding tax, tax rebates, INPS or double taxation. These references therefore cannot be used to attribute to the news a consequence that the text does not describe. The only concrete connection provided by the article is the general reference to household budgets and current expenses.
Also outside the text are the exact amount of the additional burden for a single household, any possible difference between personal circumstances and a numerical measure of overall coverage. The article does not provide these figures; therefore, the political position should be read as a campaign argument, not as a simulation of every reader's budget.
The assessment of whether the funding is sufficient must also be correctly attributed. It is not presented as a neutral fact or as an independent calculation: it is the judgment of the PLR, expressed by co-president Susanne Vincenz-Stauffacher, according to which less than half would be financed by the project. For the section on premiums cited in the source, an in-depth analysis is available at assicurazione malattia.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. To follow the vote without attributing to the source numbers it does not contain, the cross-border worker can organize the reading into four steps.
### A practical fact sheet
1. Identify the measure. This concerns the increase in VAT intended to finance the 13th AVS, not a dispute over its payment. 2. Establish the numerical figure. The standard rate increases by 0,4 percentage points and reaches 8,5%; the increase was approved in June by the Chambers. 3. Separate the arguments. The PLR identifies as risks the damage to purchasing power and the economy, the burden on household budgets, and coverage deemed insufficient. The party links the pressure on budgets to health insurance premiums, rent, and current expenses. 4. Note the date. The decision will go before the people in the popular vote of 29 novembre. The source does not anticipate the outcome and does not describe the next step.
This outline makes it possible to keep political facts separate from personal assessments. If the reader is estimating their own budget, they cannot derive from this text a withholding, an increase in monthly spending, or a specific effect on income: none of these amounts is indicated. They can instead use the available data to understand which part of the measure the PLR contests and what reasons it gives in support of a no vote.
For the cross-border worker, the most accurate verification therefore remains limited to the subject of the source: VAT, 13th AVS, household finances, and the 29 novembre vote. The news does not replace a personal table and does not contain instructions on documents, offices, or applications to submit. item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Province of Como and Carlazzo sign the Program Agreement. - The new road costs 1.242.383,84 euros. - The route bypasses the historic center of Carlazzo. - Provincial funds will be disbursed during 2026.

Province of Como and the Municipality of Carlazzo have signed a Program Agreement for the construction of the new connecting road between Via per San Pietro and Via Provinciale. The route is planned near the former plant nursery area, in the municipal territory of Carlazzo, along SP 10 della Val Cavargna.
The project has a total cost of 1.242.383,84 euros. The Municipality of Carlazzo will finance the project with 1.042.383,84 euros, while the Province of Como will contribute 200.000 euros. The funds come from their own budgets and will be disbursed during 2026.
### The connection and cross-border workers’ traffic
The new route will connect SP 10 della Val Cavargna with Via per San Pietro without passing through the historic center of Carlazzo. Today, that part of the town is affected by significant traffic, particularly due to the daily passage of cross-border workers. The road network is described as narrow, winding and unsuitable for the transit of medium-sized vehicles.
The President of the Province of Como, Fiorenzo Bongiasca, explained: «With this Program Agreement, the Province of Como confirms its commitment to the safety and efficiency of the provincial road network».
For those crossing the border for work, the concrete element of the agreement is the planned connection that will bypass the historic center. The text links the new road to easing traffic in the town, improving residents’ quality of life and facilitating the journeys of those who cross the border every day. No opening date, travel times or numerical estimate of the reduction in traffic are provided.
The road will also serve as access to the future development of sports facilities that the Municipality is developing precisely in the former plant nursery area. The Municipality will handle all technical and administrative activities, from design to final inspection, taking on the role of contracting authority. The Province will supervise the implementation of the project. The Mayor of Carlazzo, Piera Antonella Mazza, described the project as one that has been awaited for many years and is destined to benefit the historic center. ### What changes in the daily commute
To read the news from the cross-border worker's point of view, the comparison must be made between the road network described today and the function assigned to the new route. The source presents a road project designed to ease passage through the historic center and facilitate the travel of those who cross the border for work.

The first expected effect is therefore a different distribution of traffic within the built-up area. For residents, the objective declared by the authorities is to ease traffic in the historic center. For the cross-border worker, the stated benefit is the possibility of having a connection between SP 10 of Val Cavargna and Via per San Pietro without passing through the heart of Carlazzo.
The difference remains tied to the construction of the project. The Program Agreement defines the connection, the funding and the administrative responsibilities, but the source does not provide an opening date, a work schedule, an estimate of the minutes saved or data on the number of vehicles that will be diverted away from the center. For this reason, the result can be described in terms of its intended function, not as an already measured reduction in traffic.
Access to the future sports facilities also broadens the usefulness of the route beyond the mere passage of cross-border workers. The road is in fact connected both to the road network of Val Cavargna and to the development of the former nursery area. For the cross-border commuter who crosses the border every day, the procedure set out in the agreement makes it possible to follow the project's development through precise administrative steps. The Province of Como, on the other hand, will be responsible for overseeing implementation and paying its contribution in two installments.
1. Distinguish the agreement from the road that is already open. The text authorizes the construction of the link, but does not indicate a date for opening it to traffic. 2. The Municipality remains responsible for the project's activities, while the Province oversees the implementation of the project. 4. Verify the completion of the works and approval of the final acceptance certificate. Only at the end of this step will the remaining 20% of the provincial contribution be disbursed. 5. Once built, the link will connect the SP 10 of Val Cavargna with Via per San Pietro without passing through the historic center, and will also serve the area of the future sports facilities.
This sequence helps to correctly interpret future updates. Approval of the executive project is the first financial milestone indicated by the source; completion of the works and final acceptance represent the final one. The minimum wage in the hospitality and catering sector will increase by 0.6% in 2027. The decision was set by the sector’s social partners and corresponds to expected inflation, according to a joint statement issued in Basel.
The agreement was communicated by the employer organisations GastroSuisse, HotellerieSuisse and Swiss Catering Association, together with the worker representatives Hotel & Gastro Union, Syna and Unia. The adjustment concerns the sector’s minimum wages and stems from a mechanism that the employer organisations and trade unions had already agreed on last year.
The decision is based on the inflation forecasts of the State Secretariat for Economic Affairs, identified in the source by the acronym SECO. The increase is therefore presented by the social partners as an adjustment to the expected inflation for 2027.
### The decision of the social partners
For an employee holding a federal certificate of practical training or an equivalent qualification, i.e. Cat. II, the gross monthly salary will rise from 4'070 to 4'094 francs. The change therefore concerns a minimum level expressed in gross monthly francs and is not described in the source as a general change to all wages in the sector.
The move from 4'070 to 4'094 francs is the only quantified wage level in the statement. The statement identifies the profile through the federal certificate of practical training or the equivalent qualification and lists the amounts as gross monthly salary.
In the statement, the parties specify that this agreement allows them to «focus on negotiations concerning the new collective labour agreement». ## The mechanism already agreed
The increase announced for 2027 does not stem from negotiations started from scratch. The employers' organizations and the sector's trade unions had already agreed last year on the mechanism used to determine the adjustment. The decision now communicated therefore applies a criterion already shared by the social partners.
The parameter referred to is the expected rise in prices. SECO's inflation forecasts form the basis on which 0.6% was set for the minimum wages in the hotel and catering sector. The source does not attribute the announcement to a single person: it presents it as a joint position of the employers' associations and workers' representatives.
On one side are GastroSuisse, HotellerieSuisse and Swiss Catering Association. On the other are Hotel & Gastro Union, Syna and Unia. The timeline reported by the social partners is precise: the winter season ends no later than 30 April 2027. The summer season begins the following day, on 1 May 2027. For seasonal contracts, therefore, the start of the summer season marks the entry into force of the minimum wage increases.

Over 20mila toys intended for children, more than 300 electrical devices and about 300 textile products were seized during inspections carried out in recent days by the Guardia di Finanza of Varese at various commercial establishments in Busto Arsizio and Saronno. The tally also includes three merchants sanctioned and two reported for commercial fraud.
### The inspections and seizures
The Busto Arsizio Group and the Saronno Company operated as part of the provincial inspection effort against the sale of non-compliant and potentially dangerous products. Irregularities emerged in goods displayed for sale in three stores.
In two commercial establishments in Busto Arsizio, run by Chinese nationals, officers seized about 20mila toys intended for children and more than 300 electrical devices. The items were found to lack the necessary safety requirements.
The source reports that some of the products lacked the CE marking, necessary to certify compliance with European standards concerning safety, health and environmental protection. On other items, the mark was present but non-compliant, with the risk of misleading buyers about the goods’ actual safety characteristics.
In Saronno, by contrast, Guardia di Finanza officers inspected a store run by Italian nationals. About 300 textile products lacking the minimum mandatory information about the characteristics of the items were identified and seized there. The total value of the seized goods exceeds 30mila euro.
At the end of the investigations, the three owners were reported to the competent Chamber of Commerce for administrative penalties, assessed at approximately 10mila euro in total. The two merchants from Busto Arsizio were also reported to the Public Prosecutor’s Office for commercial fraud, an offense provided for by article 515 of the criminal code, for selling products of a quality different from that declared.

Varese return to Masnago after securing their first league win away at Pontedera. The red-and-whites now seek further confirmation in front of their home crowd, with a fixture scheduled at the Franco Ossola for Sunday 27 September at 15.
Opposing them will be Lentigione, an Emilia-based team that opened the league season with three consecutive wins. The run ended in the home match lost 1-0 against Cittadella Modena. Varese are therefore preparing to host a team coming off a negative result, but which had recorded three wins in its first outings.
### A test of maturity at Masnago
For the team led by Andrea Ciceri, the match represents a test of maturity. The coach linked the first win of the season to the need to continue along the same path. In his assessment of the matches played so far, Ciceri distinguished results from performances: the contexts, qualities and strategies of the opponents have changed, while his assessment remains positive of the way Varese have held their own on the pitch.
The home fixture thus takes on a precise meaning in the coach's words. Varese want to turn their home stadium into a constant, playing there more consistently and seeking a flow of play tied to the dimensions of the pitch and the spaces to attack. The coach did warn, however, that the challenge will be different from the previous outings, because Lentigione offer aggression, forward play and attacks into space.
> «We are facing a very aggressive team that plays forward and attacks the spaces».
The matchup therefore puts Varese up against an opponent with an attacking identity described directly by Ciceri. The team will have to contend with this approach in a match that comes after the win at Pontedera and gives the red-and-whites the chance to build on the result. To face it, Varese will have to play under pressure, deny depth, compete for second balls and exploit the little space the opponents habitually allow.

The defendant, accused of the murder of Fabio Limido and the attempted murder of Lavinia Limido, was sentenced to life imprisonment. ### The courtroom confrontation Manfrinati was not present in the courtroom. His defense attorney, Elio Giannangeli, returned to the general mitigating circumstances and premeditation, which the defense had already asked to have excluded.

Kastritis praised Virtus, who arrived at Masnago with a perfect approach and great solidity from the first minute. Varese knew how dangerous the Bologna team was on the boards and in offensive transition, but in the opening minutes they were slower to react and match the initial intensity. The coach did not, however, want to place the blame on his players. Virtus, he explained, is one of the strongest teams in the league, and its performance can serve as an example of how to play at this level.

In the third quarter, Pallacanestro Varese made a major effort. The team managed to match Virtus's physical level and do the right things on both ends of the court, almost completely erasing the deficit. The comeback was not completed, however: in the fourth quarter, on two or three key possessions, Varese was unable to stay within reach.
Kastritis recalled that many players have had physical problems in recent weeks and are not yet at their best, despite having worked hard. item.title: Dumenza, three home burglaries and one failed attempt
item.description: Three homes targeted in Dumenza on the evening of Friday, September 25: cash, gold and money stolen. A fourth attempt failed.
item.content:encoded:
## In brief - Three thefts committed in Dumenza in a single evening - Via Santuario, via Fiume and via Dante targeted - 600 euros, gold and other money stolen - A fourth break-in failed on via XX Settembre
## Key facts - When → Friday 25 September - Where → Dumenza - Completed thefts → three - Failed attempts → one - Money stolen → 600 euros on via Santuario - Streets affected → via Santuario, via Fiume, via Dante and via XX Settembre - Investigations → Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station
### The four incidents
Three home burglaries successfully carried out and a fourth failed attempt over the course of a single evening. This is the sequence recorded in Dumenza on Friday 25 September, where several homes were targeted by unknown perpetrators.
On via Santuario, the thieves managed to enter a home and took 600 euros in cash. Another theft was reported on via Fiume: in this case too, the criminals managed to enter a house and, after searching for valuables, took gold.
A third theft was committed in a home on via Dante. In this case, the haul consisted of gold and money, taken before the perpetrators managed to get away and disappear without a trace.
The situation was different on via XX Settembre. The unknown individuals heard the owners inside the home and decided to flee. The theft was not completed, but in this incident too the perpetrators managed to disappear without a trace.
The incidents affected four streets in the small municipality north of Varese. In three homes the theft was completed, while in the fourth case the attempt was interrupted after the owners were heard inside the house. The people concerned reported the incidents to the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station. ## The targeted homes
The reconstruction of the cases begins on via Santuario, where the reported haul was 600 euros in cash. On via Fiume, by contrast, the perpetrators searched for valuables inside the home and took gold.
The third incident, on via Dante, involved a haul consisting of gold and money. The perpetrators managed to get away after taking whatever they found in the home, disappearing without a trace. On via XX Settembre, the outcome was different: the presence of the owners prompted the unknown individuals to flee before the theft could be completed.
### Hauls and outcomes
| Street | Outcome | Haul or circumstances | |---|---|---| | via Santuario | Completed theft | 600 euros in cash | | via Fiume | Completed theft | Gold | | via Dante | Completed theft | Gold and money | | via XX Settembre | Failed attempt | The owners were at home |
The string of incidents is described as unfortunately record-breaking for the small municipality. The figure concerns the concentration of the incidents: three completed thefts and a fourth attempted break-in on the same evening. The homes are located on different streets, but all within the territory of Dumenza.
The evening thus resulted in four reports with two distinct outcomes. On the one hand, the thieves managed to enter three homes and steal cash, gold, or both. On the other, the attempt on via XX Settembre ended when the unknown individuals heard the residents. After fleeing, the perpetrators of the three completed thefts also disappeared without a trace.
The available information links the individual incidents to their respective addresses: via Santuario for the 600 euros, via Fiume for the gold, via Dante for gold and money, via XX Settembre for the failed attempt. The Dumenza Carabinieri Station is now focusing its investigations on this sequence. ## The Carabinieri investigation
Following reports from the people concerned, the Carabinieri of the Dumenza Station are carrying out investigations to reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the thefts.
The investigators' work concerns the sequence recorded on the evening of Friday 25 September, with three completed thefts and a fourth attempt that was not carried through. The checks concern the homes indicated on Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, where the incidents described occurred.
For the failed break-in, the reported circumstance is the presence of the owners inside the house. After hearing them, the unknown individuals decided to flee. In the other three cases, however, the perpetrators managed to enter the homes, take the items mentioned and leave without a trace.
### The request to residents
The appeal to the public is to report to the Carabinieri any suspicious people or cars noticed on Friday evening in the areas concerned. The request concerns not only the streets where the homes were targeted, but more generally the territory of Dumenza.
Any detail could prove useful to the investigation. For this reason, both observations possibly made in the areas of Via Santuario, Via Fiume, Via Dante and Via XX Settembre, and those collected in other areas of the municipality on the same evening, are being recalled.
Residents' reports add to those already submitted by the people affected by the thefts. The investigations by the Carabinieri of the local Station will reconstruct what happened and try to identify those responsible for the sequence of incidents recorded in Dumenza.

They are a 32-year-old resident of Switzerland and a 25-year-old resident of the province of Monza. According to the evidence gathered during the investigation, the two are believed to have been involved in the heist committed on 24 aprile, when four people with their faces covered reached the shopping center in a rental car.
The robbery took place within a few minutes. While one of the group waited in the car, the others entered the jewelry store armed with a pistol and with their faces concealed by balaclavas. They threatened the employees and smashed the glass display cases with hammers, taking numerous gold jewelry items.
The total value of the stolen jewelry was estimated at approximately 90mila euro. Due to its manner and speed, the action was described as resembling a scene from a Hollywood action film. ## The investigation into the gang
### The previous arrests
The arrests on September 25 represent a new stage in the investigative activity launched after the assault on the Bennet jewelry store in Tavernola. The Como Mobile Squad reconstructed the participants’ roles and gathered evidence considered significant against all those involved in the robbery.
The investigation also concerns the mastermind behind the heist. The source reports that the most recent operation forms part of a broader context, in which the other three members of the gang had already been arrested in April and May 2026. The robbery had been committed by four individuals, with tasks divided between those waiting outside and those entering the store.
During the investigations following the arrests, searches were carried out. Those activities also uncovered part of the stolen goods, before they could be fenced. The recovered jewelry was returned to the Stroili jewelry store, which had been targeted in the assault.
The reconstruction includes several details described by investigators: the rental car used to reach Bennet, the covered faces, the gun shown to the employees, and the hammers used to smash the display cases’ glass. The haul consisted of numerous gold jewelry items, taken within a matter of minutes.
The Mobile Squad’s work focused both on the actual execution of the robbery and on identifying the participants and the alleged mastermind. The previous arrests and searches added details to the reconstruction of the heist and enabled some of the jewelry to be recovered. ## What happens now
### The procedural phase
After notification of the pretrial detention order, the two men arrested on 25 September were taken to the Como Prison. Their position remains linked to the investigation records and the evidence gathered by the Como State Police, coordinated by the Public Prosecutor’s Office.
The next step indicated by the source is the confirmation in court of the evidence that emerged during the investigations. The arrests were carried out on the basis of the order issued by the GIP of Como, while the strength of the evidence gathered will have to be verified in the proceedings.
From an investigative standpoint, the most recent operation fits into a sequence that had already led to the arrest of the other three members of the gang in the months of April and May 2026. The searches had also made it possible to recover some of the jewelry stolen from Stroili and return it to the store.
The matter remains focused on the proceedings relating to the robbery on 24 April at Bennet in Tavernola. The elements cited include the haul of approximately 90mila euro, the involvement of four individuals with different roles, the use of a rental car and the action carried out with a pistol, balaclava and hammers.
For the two arrested men, the next stage will therefore be the procedural one, identified in the records as the venue for confirmation of the investigative evidence. Until that stage, the reconstruction remains the one that emerged from the work of the State Police, the Como Mobile Squad and the Public Prosecutor’s Office.

item.title: Claudio Zali's lifetime pension: political doubts
item.description: Mps deputies seek clarification on the early withdrawal of 700,000 francs and the pension calculation for the resigning minister
item.content:encoded:
## In brief
- Sergi and Pronzini ask for clarifications about Zali's pension entitlement - The order dismissing the case is dated 6 marzo 2019 - The advance withdrawal indicated is approximately 700mila franchi - The questions concern calculation, reduction and insurance period
- Main figures → Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies - Subject → Claudio Zali's pension case - Decision → order signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani - Withdrawal → approximately 700mila franchi - Effective date → pension entitlement starting on 1° ottobre - Reform → parliamentary amendment during 2020
### The interpellation reopens an issue already discussed
Claudio Zali's departure from the Council of State of the Canton of Ticino prompted Giuseppe Sergi and Matteo Pronzini, Mps deputies, to submit an interpellation to the government. The two are asking for clarifications about the pension entitlement of the Lega minister who resigned and argue that his pension case is still far from clear. The issue had already emerged in 2018, after Pronzini's reports.
The reports led, in March of the following year, to an order dismissing the case signed by Attorney General Andrea Pagani with regard to Zali. The measure concerned the advance withdrawal intended to finance his primary residence, requested and obtained by the State Councillor in March 2016. The date indicated for the order is 6 marzo 2019.
### The move from the Court of Appeal to the government
Sergi and Pronzini start from that order. According to the interpellation, when Zali moved from the Court of Appeal to the Council of State, the occupational pension contributions were taken in by the Canton of Ticino, as provided for by the cited law. In return, the years spent in the service of the State as a teacher and magistrate would have been counted as years of service on the Council of State to determine the pension entitlement upon leaving the government.
The two parliamentarians' reading is that Zali had been entitled to the maximum pension entitlement from day one without paying a franc in pension contributions. They link this situation to the former pension rules for State Councillors, which they describe as still valid for the majority of the members of the current Executive.
The administrative chronology includes further steps. On 28 settembre 2015, an internal opinion from Ipct, sent by email to the entire Council of State by the then deputy director, indicated that the advance withdrawal would have an impact on the future pension entitlement. On 27 novembre 2015, Zali forwarded to Ipct the application for an advance withdrawal, a pledge arrangement and authorization for a registration notice in the land registry, for approximately 700mila franchi. On 2 dicembre 2015, the Council of State granted the withdrawal through a government resolution and indicated that it would entail a reduction in the pension entitlement. The amount had been reported by Corriere del Ticino on 8 maggio 2018.
During 2020, parliament amended the remuneration and pension provisions of members of the Executive. The resolution had reserved the right to review the calculation of the insurance period in the event of future rules. The questions now concern the reference annual salary, who calculated the pension entitlement Zali will receive starting on 1° ottobre, the percentage reduction linked to the 700mila franchi, and the effects of the amendment on the insurance period. ## What a cross-border worker can infer
### The source's practical limitation
For someone who is a cross-border worker and works in Ticino, the news has a precise scope. The text concerns Claudio Zali's pension and the operation of the pension scheme for members of the cantonal Executive. It does not present a change concerning the G permit, AVS, LPP, LAMal, remittances or withholding tax. These topics are not linked to the interpellation.
This distinction is necessary to avoid automatically transposing the case into the everyday life of a commuter. The approximately 700 thousand francs mentioned in the interpellation are the amount of the withdrawal requested by Zali and granted by the Council of State in the case described. The source does not present them as a parameter for a payslip or for the contributions of a cross-border worker. Nor does it provide a final value for the pension, an already calculated percentage or a reference annual salary: these are precisely some of the points on which Sergi and Pronzini are asking for an answer.
The text nevertheless makes it possible to distinguish three aspects. The first is the pension position accrued in the transition from the Appeals Court to the Council of State. The second is the effect that Ipct's internal opinion and the resolution of 2 December 2015 attributed to the early withdrawal. The third is the possible consequence of the 2020 parliamentary amendment on the calculation of the insurance period. The interpellation does not say that these three aspects have already been brought together in a definitive calculation.
For the cross-border reader, the question to keep in mind is therefore which information is documented and which remains to be clarified. The source documents the existence of the political request and reconstructs the cited acts; it does not document a new rule for those who cross the border. To navigate the separate topics of Permesso G/B and AVS/LPP e rendita, it is better not to use this case as a substitute for a specific guide. The topic of withholding tax is also not addressed by the article.
The most prudent reading is this: the case concerns an individual position held by a State Councillor, the rules applicable to that role and the questions addressed to the government. As long as the available material does not include the calculation, the response to the questions and the exact effects of the 2020 reform, any further conclusion about the pension treatment of a cross-border worker would remain outside the source.
## Useful planning tools To estimate your pension strategy, use the pension planner and the pillar 3 simulator. ## How to follow the dossier
### Four steps based on the cited documents
1. Start with the subject of the interpellation. The questions are addressed to the Council of State and concern the reference annual salary, the party that calculated the pension starting from 1° ottobre, the percentage reduction linked to the withdrawal of 700mila franchi, and the effect of the change in the calculation of the insurance period.
2. Keep the 2015 documents distinct. The internal Ipct opinion appears on 28 settembre 2015; Zali's question is dated 27 novembre 2015; the government resolution arrives on 2 dicembre 2015. This sequence makes it possible not to confuse the opinion with the decision.
3. Separate the judicial step from the administrative part. The order not to proceed of 6 marzo 2019 concerns the matter of the early withdrawal and bears the signature of public prosecutor Andrea Pagani. The source cites it as the starting point of the interpellation, not as a response to the four current questions.
4. Verify the point left open since 2020. Parliament changed the remuneration and pension provision of Executive members; the 2015 resolution had reserved the right to review and amend the calculation of the insurance period in the event of new rules. The interpellation asks what effect that change had on Zali's pension. The text provided does not report the government's response.
For a cross-border reader, this is a reading procedure, not a form to fill out. The source does not indicate documents to submit, offices to contact, or a deadline for sending personal questions. It does, however, indicate the names of the acts and institutions that make up the matter: Ipct, Council of State, parliament, Court of Appeal and public prosecutor. These are the coordinates not to mix up when trying to understand whether a figure concerns a withdrawal, a reduction in the pension or the calculation of the years.
It is not possible to derive from this reconstruction a calculation for one's own payslip, nor an answer about pension provision or withholding tax. For this reason, the case should be kept separate from personal tools dedicated to cross-border work. If the question concerns your own net pay and deductions, use Frontaliere Ticino's calcolatore stipendio.
